management.title: Category Management
management.subtitle: View and organize your product categories — tree structure, storefront order and SEO per category
management.noCategoriesDesc: Start adding categories to organize your products and make it easier for customers to find them

tree.noMatchesDesc: Try another keyword or clear the search

form.name: Category Name *
form.nameHelp: ℹ️ A category is a group that brings together similar products (e.g. Clothing, Electronics, Skincare) to make it easier for your customers to find your product.
form.parentHelp: Pick a parent to make this a subcategory — subcategories show under the parent in the category tree.
form.sortOrderHelp: Lower numbers appear first in the storefront and in the tree. Same number = alphabetical by name.
form.metaTitleHelp: The title shown in Google results and the browser tab for the category page. Falls back to the category name.
form.metaDescriptionHelp: The description shown under the title in Google (150 characters is ideal). Falls back to an auto-generated one.

errors.duplicateName: A category with this name already exists in your company
errors.parentCycle: You cannot move a category inside one of its own subcategories

delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this category?
delete.hasProducts: Cannot delete category because it has associated products
delete.hasSubcategories: Cannot delete category because it has subcategories
delete.moveFirst: Move its products to another category first, then delete it.
delete.reparentFirst: Move its subcategories to another parent first, then delete it.

move.title: Move category products
move.description: All products of "{{name}}" ({{count}}) will be moved to the category you pick.
